notes: The Imdex 5, corrected: the code of launch 1636 deployed again as a new contracts-only launch on Ethereum mainnet (chain id 1). One contract, Imdex5 (src/Imdex5.sol), whose own ERC-20 share is 'The Imdex 5' (IMDEX5, 18 decimals, plain transfers, supply 0 at deployment, no cap; a mint issues, a redeem burns, nothing else mints). No launch token, pool or website. The constructor takes no arguments, calls no contract and checks no code length; it seeds the five-coin starting list (1282 INFER, 1283 MARG, 737 ZTO, 1075 SCAT, 1175 SwarmCity 0x1ae93A4D9CC0b41C594D00387B6F832a88f729b7, with the hooks from launch 1636) and sets listCount to 5. Every chain value is a constant: IMD 0xD34a99Bc0f67aE1bbd63C660e6d0b0dd03E263B7, Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90, registries 0xA47FcB220DDd1cDddA865F89029BEc1b9EcA3bf1 and 0x7c9D5ee697BfF5Ac4F10E2E54d3f40c44e48fE23, Intake 0xa43e6F75ee006411F79Ac1C84120606C2330DE82 with action oracle.request@oracle-1 at 0.5 IMD, oracle signer 0x5598aa9146215bc13eb26f2c692ad1461fd32982 (EIP-712 domain 'IdentityMD Oracle' version 2 bound to this chain and this contract), pool fee 12500, tick spacing 60. There is no owner, admin, role, setting, pause or upgrade, so no $owner argument exists and nothing is assigned to the factory or IMD. Anyone calls everything: fund, mintFirst, mint, redeem, redeemToImd, claim, ask, submit, rebalance and closeRequest; onOracleResult and onOracleFailure accept only the Intake. Unchanged from launch 1636: the 0.50% fee on mints, redeems and redeemToImd into feeImd (which pays only the 0.5 IMD oracle price and the 0.25 IMD caller rewards), idleImd, redeem in kind, redeemToImd, claim, fund, the oracle question, ask, submit, rebalance, the 25% weight cap and the 2% price stops. Only two behaviors changed, both listed in README.md 'Changes for the corrected launch': (1) _swap measures this contract's balance of the outgoing coin before and after PoolManager.take and records the increase, so held[coin] always equals what really arrived even for a coin that keeps 2% of transfers out of the PoolManager (SwarmCity); (2) _mintMore no longer reverts on a short fill: minted starts at the requested shares and for each coin delivering less than needed becomes min(minted, shares * out / need); BuyFailed only if a coin delivers nothing or minted ends at 0; it mints and emits minted, while the buyer still pays for every buy made. Two review-driven details of the same change set are also in README.md: _mintMore charges idle IMD as idleImd * minted / supply (rounded up) after the buys, so a short fill pays the idle share of the shares it receives, and ask() clears the unsubmitted answerHash when it opens a new request so a stale answer cannot be submitted while the new request is open. Tests add a 2%-tax mock coin and prove, through a first mint, two later mints, an exit to IMD and in-kind redeems by every holder, that balanceOf(contract) == held + owed for every coin at each step, that the last holder receives every coin and nothing is left owed or stranded; the held-plus-owed invariant is kept. Compiled with solc 0.8.26, optimizer 200 runs, via_ir, cancun, bytecode_hash none; runtime measured 22,662 bytes, under 24,576, with no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. Local check: forge build and forge test (123 tests, verifier fuzz seed) pass.
